basis: The domestic pig. NCBI ranks it as a subspecies of Sus scrofa (taxid 9825; synonym 'Sus scrofa domestica'); MDD does not list domestic forms separately. basis: The domestic ferret. Printed verbatim by Bush & Allman 2004a, Garwicz 2009, Jardim-Messeder 2017, Mota 2019, Pettigrew 1998, Veilleux & Kirk 2014, and now resolved from 'Putorius furo' (Heffner & Masterton 1975) and 'Mustela putorius (furo)' (Heesy 2004).
